Subject: Decision gateways: champion briefing, security milestones & procurement handoff

Thanks for joining the call earlier with NovaPay — short recap and proposed next steps below. I captured the decision gateways and what the champion (Ava) needs to get us to procurement sign-off.

Attendees (call):
- Ava Reilly (Product Lead, NovaPay) — indicated she'll own internal sell-in
- Liam O'Connor (CFO, NovaPay) — economic buyer; asked for clear ROI and pilot success metrics
- Maya Singh (Security) — raised data residency + SOC 2 questions; needs diagram + questionnaire answers
- Marissa Cole (Redwood) & Ben Carter (Redwood) & Rishi Malhotra (Redwood)

Key decision gateways we heard:
1) Economic buyer (Liam): wants a quantified pilot ROI and a one-page financial case showing cost per inference vs current infra and projected 6-month savings.
2) Security gate (Maya): will request SOC 2 evidence, data residency confirmation for EU/US, and a simple SSO/network diagram.
3) Procurement gate: standard Novapay procurement timeline — internal review then supplier onboarding (DocuSign + PO).

Champion enablement — recommended talk tracks for Ava:
- ROI opener: "We can lower per-inference cost by ~30% for our standard billing workload — here's a 4-week pilot to validate." (attach ROI bullets)
- Risk mitigation: "Redwood offers private deployment options + clear fallback routing to managed variants to preserve uptime during spikes."
- Implementation ask: "We need a 2-week pairing window with your infra team to validate SSO and KV caching for the pilot."

Immediate asks and owners:
- Ben: prepare a one-page pricing + pilot economics (target: 2 working days). Attachment: MutualActionPlan_NovaPay.xlsx contains a proposed pilot scope.
- Rishi: assemble SOC 2 excerpt and a draft SSO/network diagram for Maya (target: Jun 25).
- Ava: confirm internal procurement cadence and preferred date for a procurement check-in (procurement meeting window mentioned Fri Jul 9–16).

Attachments: MutualActionPlan_NovaPay.xlsx, MVP-latency-ROI-notes.pdf

Goal: lock a pilot kickoff and a procurement checkpoint. Please reply with any redlines to the M.A.P., and Ben/Rishi, flag any blockers you need from Ava.

—

Ava / team — quick pricing & pilot note. I pulled a compressed pricing summary and a proposed pilot structure (see attachment). Highlights:

- Pilot scope: 4 weeks, 100k tokens/day simulated production traffic, dedicated instance with autoscale guardrails.
- Pricing approach: timeboxed pilot fee (waived if enterprise contract signed within 30 days) + metered overage.
- Success metrics (what Liam asked for): 1) 10% median latency reduction for core flow, 2) 30% cost per inference improvement vs their current infra in our forecast, 3) <1% error rate for critical paths.

Ben attached a short "proposed-pricing-summary.pdf" to this thread. Rishi — if you can confirm the SOC 2 excerpt + a simple SSO diagram by EOD Jun 25, I can lock the procurement kickoff for Jul 7 on NovaPay's timeline.
